title: LLM-as-a-Fuzzy-Judge: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models as a Clinical Evaluation Judge with Fuzzy Logic
reasoning: The research incorporates 'Ethical Behavior' as one of the four primary fuzzy criteria for evaluating student performance. The model is specifically fine-tuned and tested on its ability to categorize medical student utterances into levels of ethical safety (Dangerous, Unsafe, Questionable, Mostly safe, Safe), making ethical evaluation a core component of the study.
